subject: Launch readiness: tiered batching defaults (runtime 1.22) — comms + docs ready check
body:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, Apr 22, 2026 at 9:14 AM PT
Subject: Launch readiness: tiered batching defaults (runtime 1.22) — comms + docs ready check

Team — doing a final readiness sweep for tiered batching defaults (fast / standard / cost-efficient) ahead of staged enablement.

Can you please reply-all with “green / yellow / red” for each of the below by EOD today:

1) Public docs: merged + published, and copy matches final tier naming + default behavior
   - What happens if customer doesn’t pick a tier?
   - How to override per-route / dedicated tenant precedence
   - Troubleshooting section (latency vs throughput, streaming notes)

2) Observability: dashboards live + tier breakdown working
   - latency histograms by tier/model/region
   - queue depth + batch size distribution panels
   - reason codes visible (default vs override vs overload mode)

3) Support readiness: playbook updated (common Qs, escalation path, suggested actions)

4) Rollout schedule: confirm dates + %s + abort criteria + rollback owner

Current proposed schedule (sanity check):
- Thu 4/23: internal canary (expanded) + perf-canary gates required
- Mon 4/27: Hosted API 5% traffic (2 regions) behind flag
- Wed 4/29: Hosted API 25% traffic
- Fri 5/1: Hosted API 100% (if all green)
- Dedicated: opt-in only starting Mon 4/27; no default flips without explicit tenant approval

If anything is “yellow/red”, please include the exact blocker + ETA + what decision you need.

Thanks,
Aditya
—
Aditya Rao
PM, Redwood Optimize
Redwood Inference

From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwoodinference.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, Apr 22, 2026 at 11:18 AM PT
Subject: Re: Launch readiness: tiered batching defaults (runtime 1.22) — comms + docs ready check

Green from Hosted API side.

1) Public docs: GREEN
- Docs PR is merged (saw the GitHub note come through). Copy aligns with final tier naming and “standard is default” messaging.
- FAQ includes the “if you don’t pick a tier” behavior + explicit note that tier selection does not change logging/retention.

4) Rollout schedule: GREEN (with one minor note)
- I’m good with the proposed staged ramp.
- Minor: let’s keep 5% to two regions (us-west + eu-central) but hold ap-southeast until after the 25% check. Reason: we still have slightly noisier baselines there.

Abort criteria (Hosted API):
- Fast tier: p99 latency regression > 10% sustained over 30 min OR paging alert triggers twice in 6 hrs
- Standard tier: p95 latency regression > 8% sustained over 60 min
- Any increase in 5xx error rate > 0.2% absolute over baseline

Owner for rollback: runtime on-call flips flag; Hosted API on-call handles customer comms if needed. (We can document the exact “who presses what button” in the launch brief.)

Nikhil

—
Nikhil Sharma
Product, Hosted API
Redwood Inference


From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwoodinference.com>, Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, Apr 22, 2026 at 1:07 PM PT
Subject: Re: Launch readiness: tiered batching defaults (runtime 1.22) — comms + docs ready check

Dedicated update:

1) Public docs: YELLOW
- Public page looks good, but we still need one Dedicated-specific snippet somewhere (docs or console help text) that states precedence plainly:
  customer tenant override > route policy > tier default
- This came up in a POC last week and I don’t want us to relive it on launch week.

3) Support readiness: GREEN
- Support playbook is updated (escalation path + when to recommend changing tier vs asking for override).
- The “override not taking effect” troubleshooting section is included.

4) Rollout schedule: GREEN
- Dedicated is opt-in only starting 4/27.
- No tenant defaults should be flipped automatically. We’ll do per-tenant approvals until we see a full week of stable metrics.

If we can get the precedence snippet added today/tomorrow, I’ll move docs to GREEN.

Lauren

—
Lauren Bishop
Product, Redwood Dedicated
Redwood Inference


From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwoodinference.com>, Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, Apr 22, 2026 at 2:26 PM PT
Subject: Re: Launch readiness: tiered batching defaults (runtime 1.22) — comms + docs ready check

Got it. Agree we should be unambiguous on precedence.

Action:
- I’ll add a short “Dedicated overrides and precedence” callout to the existing doc page today and request a quick re-review. We can keep it as a compact block so we don’t bloat the main flow.
- If we can’t get it merged by tomorrow morning, we’ll at least get the Console help text updated before the 5% ramp.

Will follow up with link once the change is up.

Aditya


From: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwoodinference.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, Apr 22, 2026 at 5:48 PM PT
Subject: Re: Launch readiness: tiered batching defaults (runtime 1.22) — comms + docs ready check

Thanks all.

Call based on this thread:
- Proceed with the staged rollout as proposed, with Nikhil’s region note (hold APAC until after the 25% check).
- Dedicated remains opt-in only.

Non-negotiables before we expand past 5%:
- Tiered dashboards confirmed working (tier breakdown + reason codes visible) and someone has eyeballed them during the first 60 minutes.
- Clear rollback owner identified in the launch brief (name + on-call alias) and kill switch tested.
- Docs includes the Dedicated precedence callout (or equivalent Console help text) so we don’t create support churn.

Aditya — please send an updated “readiness checklist” note tomorrow AM with the final links (docs + dashboards) and the exact ramp times.

Ava

—
Ava Chen
VP Product
Redwood Inference
